question: Amy worked 126 minutes on a project. She doubled her work time, added 41 minutes for review, removed 244 minutes as overestimate, and added 31 final minutes. How many hours did she spend total?

A warehouse stored 135 boxes. They multiplied by 8, then by 3, divided by 4 for consolidation, lost 384 to damage, multiplied by 8 again, and tripled for projection. The owner tracked 200 boxes separately. How many boxes in the final projection?
Emma had 44 dollars. She added 29, spent 41, gained 44, spent 18, earned 56, and spent 30. A store had a dozen items separately. How much remained?
A farm planted 159 saplings morning. Afternoon they doubled by 2, then quadrupled evening effort, and added 20 more. They had 45 saplings reserved separately. What was the final evening count?
A factory started with 140 units. They multiplied by 9, then by 4, added 12, lost 4051 to failure, and multiplied by 8 for recovery projection. How many units in the recovery projection?
A production run had 178 units morning. They doubled output, doubled again, multiplied by 3 afternoon shift, and added 74 evening units. What was total daily output?
A customer had 87 dollars. They spent 47 morning, divided remaining into 5 budgets, spent 7 from one, and gained 43. Converting to bill payments, how much remained?
A nonprofit started with 98 donors. They multiplied by 9, added 74 pledges, 28 mid-campaign, 62 monthly, and 62 late pledges. Converting to hours of effort, how many total pledges?
Rosa had 176 seeds. She lost 135 to pests, tripled remaining, removed 36 damaged, and multiplied viable by 9 for future planting. How many seeds for future planting?
A store had 196 items. They added 20, then 67, then 16, but returned 260 items. The assistant had 85 items separately. How many items remained in store?
A worker had 158 tasks initially. They multiplied by 7, added 44, lost 675 to cancellations, regained 58, and lost 283 more. Converting to workdays, how many days of tasks remained?
Two friends compared collections. One had 168 items, divided into 3 categories, added 13, then 70, and 15 more. How many items total?
A schedule had 20 hours. They doubled, divided into 4 slots morning, halved afternoon, and doubled evening. How many hours per person?
A group started with 107 members. They lost 24, then 55, gained 18, multiplied by 3 for capacity, and removed 117 for subgroups. What was the final count?
Kim had 20 hours of work. She multiplied by 7, added 46 overtime, multiplied by 7 again, and added 49 more hours. How many total hours worked?
A supply had 59 units. Removed 14. Then 30 more. Added 73. Gained 50. Added 39 more units. Converting to workdays, how many units total?

A student tracked 89 hours study. Morning added 36 hours. Afternoon multiplied by 7. Lost 535 to error correction. Lost 301 to revision. Gained back 36 hours. Added 35 final hours. How many hours studied?
A production started 59 units morning. Added 21. Multiplied by 7 afternoon. Divided by 4 for quality. Added 30. Tripled for shipping. Shipping included 18 overnight. What is afternoon projection?
A server started 109 requests. Multiplied by 9 per cluster. Then by 7 across units. Lost 4616 dropped. Multiplied by 7 annual. Converting to server minutes, how many annually?
A recipe needed 42 grams. Added 49 grams. Doubled mixture. Halved for portions. Multiplied by 9 for batch. Added 36 grams topping. Converting to ounces, how much final?
A team scored 227 points. Added 47 first quarter. Multiplied by 4 for projection. Added 16. Multiplied by 5 final season projection. How many points?
Two friends compared savings. One had 67 dollars. Added 62. Then 37. Halved account. Added 34. How much money?
A work schedule had 61 units. Multiplied by 6. By 2. Divided by 6. Added 77. Removed 118 for breaks. What is work time?
A student had 23 pages morning. Removed 3 pages. Divided by 2 for reading. Removed 3 more. Removed 2 more pages. Converting to reading hours, how many hours?
An artist started 43 pieces morning. Afternoon added 35. Added 3 more. Removed 26 framing. Added 64 evening. What is total pieces?
